editorial: On a quiet evening, you find yourself seated at an upscale restaurant that, beneath its polished veneer, harbors a creeping menace. Drop is a psychological thriller that turns the mundane ritual of a first date into a paranoid game, where every anonymous text drop intensifies the chill in the room. A standout moment unfolds when the camera focuses on the trembling hand of Violet, turning the phone into a character as much as a prop. You will feel the slow burn of psychological dread, perfect for fans who crave tension over clear resolution. While the pacing falters slightly in the second act, the guilt‑laden performance keeps you glued.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
similarMovies: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
